verdict.rationale: Close's own GitHub org (closeio) publishes a Python API client, which is a first-party SDK for one language. The developer portal describes the multi-language libraries (Node.js, Ruby, PHP, Go) as community libraries, not official SDKs. The published OpenAPI spec is only a building block for generating clients, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: clearly documented official SDKs across multiple languages, SDK docs or reference covering versioning and maintenance, and hands-on or independent corroboration of the Python client's quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Community libraries for Python, Node.js, Ruby, PHP, Go, and more.
